scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node tools/verify-web.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode release && node tools/verify-web.mjs --release
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:release: npm run build:release && cap sync android
scripts.build:yandex: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.yandex.config.ts --mode yandex
scripts.build:yandex:debug: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.yandex.config.ts --mode yandex-debug
